corrections.caveats: First-party README claim in three bullet points. No benchmark code, corpus, compiler, flags or CPU stated; test.c/test.cpp are round-trip correctness checks on a single Quake 3 connect infostring with no timing and no Huff_ baseline. Baseline is a game-engine adaptive Huffman, not a general incumbent such as zlib Huffman or Huff0. Output stream is not compatible with the existing Huffman format. Repo has only 3 commits (May 29 - June 2, 2022), last over 3 years ago. Repo holds both qbc.c and qbc.cpp; language shown as C++ with a C version.
